name: pyghidra-lite
description: Ghidra-based reverse engineering: decompile, disassemble, xrefs and call graphs, p-code value-flow slices, data types and raw bytes for ELF, Mach-O and PE binaries, with Swift/ObjC/Hermes support. Read-only by default.

ghidra_install_dir.title: Ghidra install directory
ghidra_install_dir.description: The extracted ghidra_<version>_PUBLIC folder (Ghidra 11.x or 12.x; needs a 64-bit JDK 21+). Leave empty to auto-detect Homebrew, /opt/ghidra or ~/ghidra.

project_dir.title: Analysis cache directory
project_dir.description: Where Ghidra projects are cached between sessions. Ghidra 12 rejects paths with a folder starting with '.'. Leave empty for ~/pyghidra-lite/projects (%LOCALAPPDATA% on Windows).

restrict_paths.title: Restrict loads to these paths
restrict_paths.description: Optional. Only binaries under these directories can be loaded (separate several with your OS path separator: ':' on macOS/Linux, ';' on Windows). Leave empty to allow any path.

allow_write.title: Allow annotate (rename/comment/prototype)
allow_write.description: Enables the annotate write tool. Every write still asks you to confirm it and is logged to annotate_audit.jsonl. Off = read-only.
